OpenAI’s Daybreak lead says the fix is higher-quality findings and far more coordination. The post Before you file that AI bug report, OpenAI has some advice appeared first on CyberScoop .

articles.title: All the security risks Anthropic is worried about before its IPO
articles.description: Anthropic has said out-of-control AI poses a threat to the world, but perhaps unsurprisingly suggests that profit will shape those decisions, too. The post All the security risks Anthropic is worried about before its IPO appeared first on CyberScoop .

articles.title: Prolific Hive and Nefilim ransomware affiliate sentenced to 70 months in prison
articles.description: Artem Stryzhak participated in a series of ransomware attacks on hospitals, government entities and law firms from the middle of 2018 to late 2021. The post Prolific Hive and Nefilim ransomware affiliate sentenced to 70 months in prison appeared first on CyberScoop .

articles.title: National cyber director rolls out latest pilot in South Carolina, this time for rural hospitals
articles.description: Like the water sector initiative, the six-month pilot program will connect rural hospitals with industry for free services. The post National cyber director rolls out latest pilot in South Carolina, this time for rural hospitals appeared first on CyberScoop .

articles.title: Crunchbase Data Shows Q3 Robotics Startup Funding Jumps 185% As US And China Lead Physical AI Push
articles.description: Venture funding to robotics startups has soared in 2026, with the bulk of investment going to companies based in China and the U.S., Crunchbase data shows. All told, global venture funding to robotics startups totaled $9.9 billion in Q3, more than double the $4.3 billion invested in Q3 2025, per Crunchbase data.

articles.title: Your AI Agents Need A Chief Operating Officer, Too
articles.description: Scaling AI agents requires treating them like employees in regulated roles, with written rules, clearly defined responsibilities and a named human manager accountable for their performance. Guest author Rick Folgmann, COO at Get Covered, tells companies they should start with tasks governed by established rules, adjust autonomy to each workflow’s risks, and regularly review results before expanding agents’ authority.

articles.title: What happens when security tools go dark before the ransomware
articles.description: A China-linked ransomware crew disabled the security tools at a critical infrastructure operator before it launched the encryptor. Most security budgets never priced that in. The post What happens when security tools go dark before the ransomware appeared first on CyberScoop .

articles.title: Some Observations About Anthropic’s IPO Filing
articles.description: In an S-1 filing today preceding what could be the largest IPO ever, Anthropic laid out extensive new details about its earnings, growth, key stakeholders and the risks it faces going forward. Clocking in at 335 pages, the document wasn’t exactly light reading. However, in a preliminary once-over, we highlight some of the more intriguing disclosures.

articles.title: When Traction Becomes Personal Exposure: What The Joonko Guilty Plea Means For Founders
articles.description: False claims about customers, revenue and AI capabilities can expose founders to personal securities-fraud liability, with D&O insurance offering limited protection against established misconduct. Guest author Kyle Jeziorski of Founder Shield shares three policy provisions that need close attention from founders.

articles.title: האייפון המתקפל לא מרשים את כולם: "אפל לא חידשה דבר כבר 15 שנה"

articles.title: לנתק ולמנוע תיקון: התוכנית של איראן לפגוע באינטרנט
articles.description: לפי רויטרס, איראן הכינה תוכניות לפגיעה בכבלי תקשורת תת-ימיים במפרץ אם תותקף שוב, ובכיר איראני הזהיר שתמנע גם את תיקונם. על הפרק: שיבושים בגלישה, בשירותי ענן ובמערכות פיננסיות שעלולים להימשך חודשים. עד כמה האיום מסכן את האינטרנט העולמי, ומה המשמעות לישראל?

articles.title: "אנשים יוצרים קשר רגשי עם הבינה המלאכותית, אבל ה–AI לא חי, זו מכונה"
articles.description: מה קורה כשענקית ה–AI אנתרופיק מכנסת בחשאי אנשי דת מרחבי העולם כדי לדון בשאלה כיצד לנהוג במערכת שפיתחה תודעה אנושית? • הרב ד"ר מואיז נבון, מבכירי מובילאיי לשעבר, הציב מול מייסדי החברה את הגבול המוסרי של היהדות: "אם אתם מאמינים ש'קלוד' הוא אנושי, אתם בעצם מעסיקים עבדים" • בריאיון ל"ממון" הוא מסביר מתי בכל זאת ייחשב מודל AI לאנושי לפי היהדות, מה הוא לעולם לא יבקש מהבינה המלאכותית לעשות, ולמה למרות הסכנות הוא לא שותף לתרחישי האימה על סוכני ה–AI

articles.title: Sundar Pichai faces boos, walkout at Stanford graduation ceremony over Google’s Israel, ICE ties

articles.title: Pro-Iran hacktivist group says it is behind attack on medical tech giant Stryker
articles.description: The hacktivist group claimed the attack was in retaliation for a U.S. strike on a Tehran school that killed more than 175 people, most of them children.

articles.title: Hacked traffic cams and hijacked TVs: How cyber operations supported the war against Iran
articles.description: After U.S. and Israeli forces started bombing Iran, reports say cyber operations have disrupted communications, supported surveillance activities, and have been used in psychological operations.

articles.title: Critics pan spyware maker NSO’s transparency claims amid its push to enter US market
articles.description: The infamous spyware maker released a new transparency report claiming to be a responsible spyware maker, without providing insight into how the company dealt with problematic customers in the past.

articles.title: Kaltura acquires eSelf, founded by creator of Snap’s AI, in $27M deal
articles.description: Kaltura acquires AI avatar startup eSelf to integrate generative AI into enterprise video and learning tools.

articles.title: Microsoft cuts cloud services to Israeli military unit over Palestinian surveillance
articles.description: The investigation was sparked by a story in The Guardian that reported that Unit 8200, the elite Israel military intelligence unit, was using Azure cloud storage to house data on phone calls obtained through the surveillance of Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank.

articles.title: Israel announces seizure of $1.5M from crypto wallets tied to Iran
articles.description: The Israeli government ordered the seizure of 187 wallets it said belong to the IRGC, which have over time received $1.5 billion in crypto, according to a blockchain analysis firm.

articles.description: Israel-based eVTOL startup AIR has raised $23 million to scale production of both its piloted and uncrewed cargo aircraft, and enter the U.S.

articles.title: Iran’s government says it shut down internet to protect against cyberattacks

articles.title: Internet collapses across Iran, say web-monitoring firms

articles.title: Paragon says it canceled contracts with Italy over government’s refusal to investigate spyware attack on journalist
articles.description: The Italian government claims that accepting Paragon’s help would have compromised national security and classified information.

articles.title: Court document reveals locations of WhatsApp victims targeted by NSO spyware

articles.title: Researchers name six countries as likely customers of Paragon’s spyware
